blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Bank of the Philippine Islands (BPI) has partnered with DMCI Homes to let its US-based property buyers pay through their American bank accounts, simplifying overseas payments and the developer’s collections. On Tuesday, the Ayala-led bank said DMCI Homes is the first developer to use its overseas collection arrangement (OCA), which combines digital enrollment, […]...
